frozen_root_causes.scope_rule: The remediation may target only these four frozen mechanisms and the minimum shared infrastructure required to express them. Any additional scientific behavior change requires a separately frozen amendment before implementation.

fail_closed_boundary: Class/object method syntax need not become a FUNCTION fact in v0.2, but declaration syntax must never be promoted to a CALL.
Unsupported or ambiguous callable syntax may be omitted or marked incomplete; it may not be guessed into semantic authority.
mechanism_generic_obligations.name: JS_TS_DECLARATION_AWARE_CALL_EXTRACTION
required_semantics: A function declaration header is never emitted as CALL merely because it contains identifier followed by open-parenthesis.
An arrow-function declaration is never emitted as CALL merely because its declaration contains callable-looking syntax.
Within the explicitly supported bounded JS/TS subset, every real call expression is emitted at its structural call-expression span, including nested call expressions.
Call ownership is the structurally containing function body, not merely the last preceding declaration.

fail_closed_boundary: An expression containing ambiguous unsupported operator structure must be marked/treated incomplete rather than split by heuristic into a false semantic comparison.
No name, comment, fixture family, expected observation, or root-cause label may determine whether a COMPARE is emitted.
mechanism_generic_obligations.name: JS_TS_EXPRESSION_LEVEL_COMPARISON_EXTRACTION
required_semantics: COMPARE extraction is expression-context independent within the supported subset.
A supported binary comparison in IF condition, RETURN expression, assignment RHS, or call argument emits the same COMPARE fact shape with exact operands, operator, scope, and structural span.
Existing IF comparisons are emitted exactly once; extending expression coverage must not duplicate them.
Comparison-looking text in comments or string/template literal content is not a COMPARE fact.

fail_closed_boundary: Raw line order and substring coincidence are provenance only.
If balanced structural ownership cannot be uniquely established, the surface is incomplete rather than guessed.
mechanism_generic_obligations.name: JS_TS_CANONICAL_STRUCTURAL_SPANS
required_semantics: RETURN facts are owned and delimited by a balanced-delimiter structural scan, not by a regex that truncates at a closing object brace.
For a supported object-literal return, the RETURN boundary and its representation owner use a canonical composable structural span convention.

The canonical relation required for return-object effect candidates is exact owner equality or another prospectively declared deterministic relation that makes the representation operation admissible without source-name heuristics.
Single-line and multiline object returns, nested object/array values, optional terminal semicolons, and harmless whitespace do not change semantic ownership.

fail_closed_boundary: No change to non-RETURN Python call semantics is authorized unless required to prevent duplicate emission caused directly by this remediation.
No callee-name allowlist or fixture-specific source pattern is permitted.
mechanism_generic_obligations.name: PYTHON_RECURSIVE_CALL_OBSERVABILITY_UNDER_RETURN
required_semantics: A Call-valued RETURN emits the outer call and recursively emits every syntactically nested call expression under that returned expression.
Each call expression is emitted exactly once at its AST-derived span.
A simple return f(x) therefore emits one CALL, while return outer(mid(inner(x))) emits three distinct CALL facts.
The remediation preserves stdlib AST authority and does not infer calls from labels or source substrings.

implementation_audit_required: Reject implementation code containing the prospective microfixture IDs or frozen 8 failure IDs.
Reject implementation logic that compares source hashes, source slices, expected observations, or diagnosis categories.
Require the same extraction algorithm to process base fixtures and metamorphic variants.
